The ao state is the neutral undissociated solute in a hypothetical ideal solution at unit molality, with the activity coefficient referred to infinite dilution. Unit molality is not 1 mol/m3 or 1 mol/L, and this reference is not a measured saturated solution. The same-compilation gas and aqueous G values define a standard gas-dissolution equilibrium constant; they do not supply a gas-transfer coefficient, salinity correction or oxygen replenishment rate.
